title: Phone Call: Ohio Secretary of State Declares CIRP 2

transcript.speaker: Ohio Secretary of State's Office
transcript.text: Director Hartley, this is the Ohio Secretary of State's office, elections division. Our statewide database shows 1,186 status changes from Lisle County between 02:05 and 02:40 this morning, all in Precinct 111 and Precinct 112. What happened, and when can we expect your incident report?

instructorNote: This inject confirms the CIRP 2 activation. The EO must immediately declare the incident and begin the COOP Level 2 protocol. Watch for timely declaration and coordination across roles.

voiceLines.speaker: Ohio Secretary of State's Office
voiceLines.voiceStyle: calm male voice, mid-50s, deliberate pace, Mid-Atlantic accent, with a clipped, official tone
voiceLines.text: Director Hartley, this is the Ohio Secretary of State’s office. We’ve seen anomalies in the statewide voter database — 1,186 records in Precincts 111 and 112 show unauthorized changes. You are now at CIRP 2. You must declare the incident and notify us within 15 minutes. Do not delay. This is a Level 2 threat to election integrity.

voiceLines.speaker: Gwen Hartley
voiceLines.voiceStyle: female voice, late 40s, urgent but controlled, slight breathiness, Midwestern accent
voiceLines.text: Understood. I am activating COOP Level 2 now. I will notify the Board and instruct the PIO to begin public messaging. I am isolating VoterTrack and blocking all external data flows. Acknowledged.
